concepts.description: Tactile editorial scene: a simple blank standing calendar on the left and three blank production record folders on the right, meeting at an open reconciliation point. One small chip-package tray grounds the industry. Blank paper has no fake digits or microtext. Two sides waiting to meet, not automated integration. Distinct from the reference desk arrangement.
